title: Synthesizers
subtitle: How a sound is built
summary: Why a clarinet and a flute playing the same note sound different, how a filter makes a buzz into a vowel, and why the order of two guitar pedals matters. Each lesson opens on a puzzle from the history of sound (Helmholtz's glass spheres, a tape cut with a razor, a vibrato turned up until it became a bell) and works it out on a live synthesizer you play as you read. Beside the lessons are a synth to play freely and PatchMatch, a game of matching sounds by ear.
